name: Grafana
description: Dashboards and graphs for any data source.
notes: Log in as admin; the password is in /opt/grafana/.nova-secrets (SECRET1).
compose:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:latest
    container_name: grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:3000"
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: "{SECRET1}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/var/lib/grafana
